summary.notes: Four of six claims are RC-4 (conflict_requires_block). The two RC-2 claims are non-blocking procedural guards aligned with constitutional principles. No role-matched citation to SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_SEQUENCE_v1.md is provided for any of the strong architecture claims.
